instruction: Right now you're facing towards a closed door. Now turn behind and move forward towards the couch which is in front of you. Now turn left, there is an open door in front of you, move towards the door and exit the room. Now turn left, you can see an open door in front of you, move towards the door and enter in to the room. There is an open door to your left, move towards the door and turn left. Now enter in to the room and move a bit forward towards the wall. Now slightly turn left, there is an open entrance in front of you, move towards the entrance and enter in to the room. Now slightly turn right, there is an open door in front of you and towels to your left, move towards the open door and enter in to the room and stand in the room, there is a door to your left and a toilet basin to your right and it is your end point.
